## Bar plot creation
```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = clarity, fill = cut)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Diamond Clarity by Cut",
    x = "Clarity",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Cut Quality"
  )
```
